fusions.name: The Wait Ends
fusions.desc: Clamps down on the target with a bite that deals 32 damage and is always a critical hit. It uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times the damage they had left.

fusions.name: Lashing Tail
fusions.desc: Sweeps a wide cone 3.5 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it and knocks each enemy back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: After holding still for 1.5 seconds, increases your critical hit chance by 35% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Lets Go
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 15% more damage.
